_comment: Squarespace Events collections, read from the collection PAGE by mapsee_ingest_squarespace.py. `collection` is the collection page URL, NOT an individual event. Category is the mapsee frontend key and only a DEFAULT - derive_categories in mapsee_supabase_sync promotes work parties to volunteer, concerts to music and classes to fitness from the text.
_never_add_a_query_string: This adapter used to read `?format=json` and must never go back. The stock Squarespace robots.txt - identical on every site on the platform, so this is not one organiser's preference - disallows /*?format=json, /*?format=ical, /*?month= and the rest for `User-agent: *`, which is the group that applies to us. The bare page is allowed and carries what we need. Same line the DICE adapter walks: the public page yes, the endpoint robots.txt names no.
_a_venue_block_is_effectively_required: The page carries NO coordinates - mapLat does not appear in the markup at all - and the only address it offers is a Google Maps link with the street and city glued together, which the adapter refuses to split unless this config's own `city` confirms the boundary. So placement comes from `venue` {name, address, city, region, postal_code, lat, lon}; a site without one will have most of its events skipped as unplaceable. Measured on Volunteer Park Trust: 4 of 16 upcoming events carry an address at all.
